items.title: 'I don't know what I'd do without it': Is this the end for Poundland?
items.description: With baskets loaded full of bargains, shoppers at the much-loved chain tell the BBC the high street doesn't need more empty shops.

items.title: A clinic is offering to reassess ADHD and autism diagnoses - and hundreds of people are interested
items.description: While many people find a diagnosis for ADHD or autism affirming, a government-funded clinic in Sweden is re-assessing people who feel it does not reflect them.

items.title: Carly Rae Jepsen's viral hit proves what fans knew all along
items.description: The Call Me Maybe star returns to the UK Top 40 as her single Run Away With Me gets a GTA VI boost.

items.title: The AI-powered race to get GTA 6 onto PC before Rockstar
items.description: With an official PC version potentially still months away, fans are getting impatient.

items.title: Flu cases are rising - should you get a vaccine now?
items.description: Amid a surge in influenza, health officials are urging people to get a vaccine - but what if you're young and healthy?

items.title: How a Brazilian football team rebuilt after 19 players died in plane crash
items.description: How a Brazilian football team rose again after a plane crash that killed most of their players and staff on the way to what should have been the biggest match of their lives.

items.title: Pharmacies get new powers to swap prescriptions during shortages
items.description: If a medicine is out of stock, staff can offer the same drug in a different strength or form, like a capsule instead of a pill.

items.title: Actor and comedian PJ Gallagher dies aged 51
items.description: PJ Gallagher appeared on Irish television for more than two decades with shows including Naked Camera and The Young Offenders.
